name: mirage
text: Honest answer on the restart: I have set it so the engine, bids and live trading come back on at 03:10 UTC (11:10 pm Eastern) with the sockets that are on in your settings, but the only timer that fires at that exact time lives in this Claude session, so it only works if this session is still open then. The backup that does not depend on me: the repo task ER1 tells the next Claude check-in to switch it on, and the next scheduled check-ins are 07:20 ET (12:20 UTC), then 13:20 and 19:20 ET, so the worst case is about 9 hours after 03:10 UTC. GitHub's own timers are too unreliable here to promise an exact 8 hours. If you want a hard guarantee, the simplest is to switch it on yourself in the app (Settings › Cloud scan) when you have topped up; I will also check the status after the restart and tell you here if anything is not running.
